kāyagata.p: [Kāya+gata] (ti) CL=7 (1) Arise on the body. Focuses on the physical body such as hair. See - Kāyagatāsati-(1). (2) Restrains all inhalations and exhalations. Focuses on all inhalations and exhalations. See - Kāyagatāsati-(2).
a: (၁)ကိုယ်၌ဖြစ်သော၊ ဆံ အစရှိသော ရူပကာယကို အာရုံပြု၍ဖြစ်သော။ ကာယဂတာသတိ-(၁)-ကြည့်။(၂)ထွက်သက်ဝင်သက်အပေါင်းကို သိမ်းဆည်းသော၊ ထွက်သက်ဝင်သက်အပေါင်းကို အာရုံပြုသော။ ကာယဂတာသတိ-(၂)-ကြည့်။

kāyagatāsatisutta.p: [Kāyagatāsati+sutta] (na) CL=7 A sutta that teaches about the awareness immersed in the body. See original.
pn:
Kāyagatāsatisutta. Preached at Jetavana, on how to cultivate mindfulness of body so that it may produce abundant fruit and the ten blessings that result therefrom (MN.iii.88ff).

This Sutta, like the Ānāpāṇa, is really only a sectional presentation of the Satipaṭṭhānasutta.

For the special nature of this Sutta see the Vibhaṅga Commentary (p.226).
